title: Customer Commitment Velocity Governor and Runway Calculator
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: high-touch account requests and escalations are inflating our roadmap commitments. PMs and Engs are lacking a consistent, defensible way to translate incoming customer signals into a realistic commitment runway. Goals: (1) create a deterministic scoring function that converts customer signals (ARR, severity, renewal window, exec sponsor, legal constraints) into a prioritized commit score; (2) produce a runway calculator that maps commit score to sprint-level capacity allocations and decommit fallback timelines; (3) expose an operational UI in Console for PMs to see allocation, reasoned trade-offs, and suggested counteroffers; (4) build automation to apply negotiated fallbacks (partial delivery, date windows, pilot tracks) and generate commitment audit logs. Success metrics: reduction in roadmap scope slippage by 30% in Q2, 20% fewer emergency reprioritizations for top 50 accounts, increased predictability in quarterly delivery (variance in committed velocity <= 12%). Out of scope: changing legal/contract terms; heavy changes to billing system. Constraints: relies on accurate customer metadata and renewal windows, so we need a robust upstream sync from CRM and Support tools. Approach: define scoring model (signals + weights), simulate historical intake to calibrate thresholds, build a lightweight service (score engine) and a Console panel, add guard rails for PM override and executive escalation, iterate with 3 pilot accounts for April cycle. Deliverables: scoring spec, calibration dataset and sim, score engine API, Console runway UI, acceptance checklist, runbook for customer communication templates.
acceptance_criteria: Score engine returns stable score for a request within 100ms and includes signal provenance
Runway calculator projects sprint allocations for at least 6 sprint horizons and flags conflicts with capacity SLOs
Console UI allows PM to propose 3 fallback offers (partial scope/date/pilot) and record the chosen fallback to audit logs
Automated notification to CSM/SE created when a top-account request moves from proposed to committed
Simulated calibration shows predicted commit vs realized commit variance under 12% on historical sample
